scope.method: All16 actual Unity PNGs opened sequentially with filename labels. No crop/resize/composite/edit was performed by reviewer. All320 displayed slots checked at overview resolution; this is not all premium frames.

characterScales.policy: One CharacterVisualSizing.Scale(previewClone) for base/signature and all5rows; no per-sprite fitting.

findings.observation: Across eight basic/signature directional images, head/body/boot silhouette scale stays broadly comparable between premium and support rows. The earlier tall small-headed support/body replacement is not apparent at this common camera scale. Motion prone figures and high-arm/clasped-hand poses correctly alter total silhouette height; these were not treated as scaling defects.

Across eight basic/signature directional images, support rows retain long dark hair, red hem, a compact body and feet at broadly comparable scale to premium. Lower/leaning attack poses are distinguishable from uniform shrinking. No entire figure, major limb or whole boot appears missing in these small overview renderings.

No figure touches the image edge or neighboring slot. The selected320 slots all have fullRectInsideFrame=true in the capture mapping. This is a geometric/overview result, not a guarantee of detailed sprite anatomy.

No obvious second arm-mounted weapon mass or detached weapon is visible in the overview. The characters render only roughly55-65 native screen pixels tall in normal upright poses, so precise glove/finger/blade counts cannot be approved from these16 images. Previous full native source-sheet inspections remain the detailed-art evidence. Velvet basic premium has the established broader claw silhouette while support sheets preserve their original narrower single forearm blade; evaluate the visible transition in final continuous playback rather than classifying its source-specific outline as an added hand weapon.

Feet stay near their corresponding row baselines at overview scale; walking stride, crouch, recoil and prone shifts are expected. These static unanimated slots do not exercise root motion or prove exact contact/foot registration.

followUpTargets.scope: Final continuous base/signature Front/Back; premium -> HQ attack -> premium and polish recovery -> HQ idle. Earlier direct evidence is Validation/farah-transition-visual.json.

Final continuous basic15_0 (previous duplicate-claw correction), premium/support hand-weapon silhouette change, recovery/idle head+boot scale, and Back root/foot continuity. Premium15_0 is not guaranteed to be among row1 sampled0/5/10/last.

limitations: The 64-image capture passed is an engine/geometry result. This reviewer viewed only the16 Farah/Velvet images, not all64.
Common camera ortho14.4170055 and53.2704239 pixels/world make individual bodies small; fine hand/blade/face quality cannot be conclusively judged here.
Tool display further reduced2048x1536 to1824x1368. Requested original does not negate this display limitation.
No exact head/boot ratio was inferred from total bounds, which include hair, weapons, pose and transparent rect padding.
Static images do not prove timing, interpolation, root movement, ground contact, VFX visibility or every premium frame. Final enlarged actual continuous rendering remains required.
No production PNG/meta/selection manifest, source code or Unity state was modified. Only this new review JSON is written.

images.assessment: No gross whole-body size replacement, canvas clipping, missing complete figure or isolated detached foot is visible at this overview scale. Prone row3col4 and leaning/wide attack poses are intentional. Fine weapon and facial details remain below reliable inspection size.
images.facingNote: Support rows retain the expected directional silhouettes. Premium attack twists are authored action poses and were not classified from head-facing alone.
